Definition: from G5557 and G3037; gold-stone, i.e. a yellow gem ("chrysolite"):--chrysolite.
BiblicalUsage: The chrysolite is one of the foundation stones of the New Jerusalem, the seventh in John's list. It is a yellow gem, named from gold and stone together, and it holds up the wall of the city of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the foundations of the holy city are made of precious things because the God who builds it spares nothing for His people.
